form_name: Medical Certificate
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Certifies an applicants physical/medical fitness to drive; mandatory for transport-vehicle applicants and for non-transport applicants above a prescribed age at renewal or fresh application.
prerequisites: Physical examination by a registered medical practitioner

form_name: Application for Learners Licence / Driving Licence / Addition of Vehicle Class / Renewal / Change of Address or Name
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Single consolidated application form covering LL issue, DL issue, adding a new vehicle class to an existing DL, DL renewal, and change of address/name on a DL.
prerequisites: Age proof, address proof, passport photo (and Form 1A where applicable)
supporting_documents: Age proof, address proof, photograph, medical certificate (conditional)

form_name: Application/Certificate related to grant of Driving Licence after driving test
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Documents the outcome of the driving skill test required before a permanent Driving Licence is granted.
prerequisites: Valid Learners Licence, driving test appointment

form_name: Medical Certificate for Transport Vehicle Driving Licence
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: A more detailed medical fitness certificate specifically for applicants seeking a licence to drive transport (commercial) vehicles.

form_name: Certificate of Completion of Driving Training Course
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Issued by an accredited driving training school certifying completion of a recognised training course, which can substitute for the standard driving test at some RTOs.
prerequisites: Enrolment in a Government-accredited driving training school

form_name: Application for Registration or Temporary Registration
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Primary application form to register a new motor vehicle, or to obtain temporary registration pending permanent RC issuance; also used to record a hire-purchase/lease/hypothecation agreement at the time of registration.
supporting_documents: Sale certificate, insurance certificate, address/ID proof
legal_basis_provision_ids: Rule 47 and Rule 53A of CMVR, 1989; PROV_MVA_S39

form_name: Sale Certificate
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Issued by the manufacturer, dealer, or a registered E-rickshaw/E-cart Association, certifying sale of the vehicle; presented along with Form 20 for registration.

form_name: Certificate of Registration
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: The prescribed format of the Registration Certificate (RC) document itself, issued once a Form 20 application is approved.

form_name: Application for Renewal of Registration Certificate
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Used to renew a Registration Certificate on or after expiry of its validity period.
prerequisites: Existing RC, valid insurance, valid PUC, fitness certificate (for vehicles beyond prescribed age)
supporting_documents: Existing RC, insurance, PUC, fitness certificate (conditional)

form_name: Application for Duplicate Registration Certificate
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Used to obtain a duplicate RC where the original has been lost, destroyed, or mutilated.
supporting_documents: FIR or affidavit of loss, ID proof
legal_basis_provision_ids: Application made to the original registering authority per CMVR, 1989, accompanied by the fee specified in Rule 81

form_name: Application for Assignment of New Registration Mark
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Used when a vehicle is permanently moved to another State/UT and requires a new registration mark under Section 47.
prerequisites: No-Objection Certificate from originating State, cleared dues/taxes

form_name: Application for No-Objection Certificate (NOC)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Obtains an NOC from the current registering authority, typically required before re-registering a vehicle in another State/UT.
prerequisites: Cleared pending challans/taxes on the vehicle

form_name: Notice of Transfer of Ownership
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Filed by the transferor (seller) to formally notify the registering authority of a change in ownership; used together with Form 30.

form_name: Report of Transfer of Ownership
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Filed by the transferee (buyer), or an authorised dealer of a registered vehicle, to complete an ownership transfer alongside Form 29.

form_name: Intimation of Unreported Transfer
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Used by a person to whom a vehicle has been transferred, but the transfer was not reported by the transferor, to intimate the registering authority directly.
prerequisites: Proof of purchase where seller has not filed Form 29

form_name: Application for Entry of Hire-Purchase / Lease / Hypothecation Agreement
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Records a loan/lease/hypothecation agreement against the vehicle in its Registration Certificate, as required under Section 51(2) of the MV Act.
legal_basis_provision_ids: Section 51(2) MVA 1988; fee per Rule 81 of CMVR, 1989

form_name: Application for Termination of Hire-Purchase / Lease / Hypothecation Agreement
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Records closure/termination of a hire-purchase, lease, or hypothecation agreement, removing the financiers interest from the RC, as required under Section 51(3) of the MV Act.

form_name: Report of Inspection for Fitness Certificate
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Inspection report prepared by a Motor Vehicle Inspector (or an Automated Testing Station) as the basis for granting or renewing a transport vehicles Fitness Certificate.

form_name: Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate
issuing_authority: State-authorised PUC testing centres
purpose: Certifies a vehicles emissions are within prescribed limits at the time of testing; format is issued by authorised PUC centres rather than a single central CMVR form number.
prerequisites: Vehicle physically present for emissions testing

form_number: Commonly informally referenced as Form 4E; exact number NOT_VERIFIED
form_name: Application for International Driving Permit
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR) / Regional Transport Office
purpose: Application to obtain an International Driving Permit for driving abroad, based on a valid Indian DL.
prerequisites: Valid Indian DL, passport, visa/travel proof, photographs

form_number: No single fixed CMVR number identified; introduced administratively
form_name: Employment Certificate / Declaration for Bharat (BH) Series Registration
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
purpose: Declares eligibility for BH-series (portable, cross-state) vehicle registration based on qualifying Government or multi-state private employment.
prerequisites: Employment certificate from a qualifying employer

form_number: Format varies by State MACT rules; no single central CMVR form number
form_name: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal - Claim Petition
issuing_authority: State Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (under Section 165 MVA)
purpose: Formal petition filed before a MACT to claim compensation for death/injury/property damage arising from a motor accident, under Section 166 (or the structured formula under Section 163A).
supporting_documents: FIR, medical records, income proof, dependency evidence

form_number: Chapter V permit application forms (specific serial number varies by permit type); NOT_VERIFIED
form_name: Application for Goods Carriage Permit
issuing_authority: Regional Transport Authority
purpose: Application to obtain a permit authorising a transport vehicle to carry goods for hire or reward, under Chapter V of the MV Act.
supporting_documents: RC, insurance, fitness certificate, tax payment proof

form_number: Chapter V permit application forms (specific serial number varies by permit type); NOT_VERIFIED
form_name: Application for Passenger Vehicle Permit (Stage/Contract Carriage)
issuing_authority: Regional Transport Authority
purpose: Application to obtain a stage carriage or contract carriage permit under Chapter V of the MV Act.
supporting_documents: RC, insurance, fitness certificate, route/area details

form_number: Insurer-specific format (e.g. IRDAI-prescribed motor claim form); not a CMVR form
form_name: Motor Insurance Claim Form
issuing_authority: Insurance company (IRDAI-regulated)
purpose: Used to file a third-party or own-damage claim under a motor insurance policy following an accident.
prerequisites: Valid insurance policy at time of accident
supporting_documents: Policy copy, FIR (for third-party claims), repair estimates/bills

form_number: Distinct from Form 26 (which covers RC); exact DL-duplicate form number NOT_VERIFIED
form_name: Application for Duplicate Driving Licence
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Used to obtain a duplicate Driving Licence where the original has been lost, destroyed, or mutilated, per Rule 26 of CMVR, 1989 (Issue of duplicate licence).
supporting_documents: FIR or affidavit of loss, existing DL number
legal_basis_provision_ids: Rule 26 of CMVR, 1989 (rule heading confirmed; exact form number NOT_VERIFIED)

form_number: State-specific format; not a single central CMVR form
form_name: Road Tax / Motor Vehicle Tax Payment Challan
issuing_authority: State Transport Department
purpose: Used to pay one-time or annual road tax due on a vehicle, a prerequisite for registration in most States.

form_number: Bank/financier-issued letter format; not a CMVR-numbered form
form_name: No-Objection Certificate from Financier (Hypothecation Closure)
issuing_authority: Financing bank/institution
purpose: Confirms a vehicle loan has been fully repaid, required before filing Form 35 to remove hypothecation from the RC.

form_number: Certificate of Deposit format under the Vehicle Scrapping Policy; exact form number NOT_VERIFIED
form_name: Certificate of Deposit / Vehicle Scrapping Certificate
issuing_authority: Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facility (RVSF)
purpose: Issued when a vehicle is deposited for scrapping at an authorised facility; used to claim available scrappage incentives and complete deregistration.

form_name: Communication of Sale by a Motor Vehicle Dealer
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (CMVR)
purpose: Reportedly used by a registered motor vehicle dealer to communicate a further sale of a vehicle it holds under a trade certificate; exact form number and rule citation NOT_VERIFIED in this session - included for completeness but should be confirmed before relying on it.
prerequisites: Vehicle held under dealer trade certificate
